translations.web: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
translations.bsb: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
translations.kjv: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
translations.asv: Wherefore putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with meekness the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
